VcamFrames.description:
What the virtual camera's session did with the frames since sending started
(the virtual camera spec, "Ring and stats").

consumer_absent.description: Frames sent while no app read the camera.

consumer_busy.description: Frames skipped or dropped for lack of room on the consumer side.

format_pending.description: Frames dropped while the camera's format was being changed.

replaced.description: Frames a newer frame replaced before the sender took them.

sent.description: Frames handed to the consumer side.

VcamInstall.description: Whether the virtual camera is on this computer (protocol 1.12, ADR-0066).

oneOf.description: Apps can list the camera.

failure.description: While sending, why the camera's node failed, until it runs again.

frames.description:

height.description: Height in pixels: sent now, or saved for the next start.

rate.description: Frames per second, rounded: sent now, or saved for the next start.

reason.description: Why, in words for the user, with `needs_update` and `unavailable`.

sending.description: RBS sends the program to the camera now.

state.description: Whether the camera is added; `null` while the app has not read it yet.

width.description: Width in pixels: sent now, or saved for the next start.
